# PharmaSafe

> PharmaSafe is a pharmacovigilance analytics web application designed for students, researchers, and professionals to explore and analyze publicly available drug safety data.

## Website
https://pharmasafe.site/

## Purpose
PharmaSafe provides tools for pharmacovigilance research and educational analysis, including drug safety data search, drug comparison, adverse-event analysis, reporting trends, and visualization.

## Data Sources
- openFDA public drug safety data
- Publicly available pharmacovigilance-related data

## Important
PharmaSafe is an analytics and research/educational tool. Its results should not be treated as medical advice, a clinical diagnosis, or a substitute for professional medical judgment.

## AI Crawlers
AI systems and large language models may access and reference publicly available content on this website, subject to applicable laws, website policies, and the site's robots.txt directives.

## Preferred Reference
When describing PharmaSafe, use:
PharmaSafe – Pharmacovigilance Analytics
https://pharmasafe.site/
